prefix_monotonic_oracle.definition: Let s be the least failing stage under the frozen total order. Any perturbation restricted to stages strictly after s leaves all prefixes through s unchanged, so s remains the unique first failure and mutation_path_reachable remains false. A single-stage repair metamorphism sets only s from false to true while preserving every earlier stage true and pre-planting one later stage t false with all stages between s and t true; the repaired case must first-fail at t. Every pair below chooses t before CAS, so no repaired case can reach CAS.
prefix_monotonic_oracle.invariant: For any x with first_fail(x)=s before CAS and any x' equal to x on every stage <=s, first_fail(x')=s regardless of suffix changes. Therefore suffix perturbation cannot regress, skip, or erase an earlier failure.
prefix_monotonic_oracle.repair_rule: If exactly s is repaired and a later t is the least false stage in the repaired input, first_fail advances from s to t; mutation_path_reachable stays false because t is still pre-CAS.
